assets.name: collection
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game UI illustration, one compact collection emblem for a polished minimalist arrow puzzle. Primary request: a single beautifully crafted small trophy, warm pale champagne metal bowl, sculptural violet loop handles, faceted smoky-lavender glass pedestal, restrained ivory highlights. Premium tactile 3D product illustration with rounded geometric edges, refined and adult, not a toy, no ornate clutter. Camera: near-front three-quarter view, very slight view from above; the whole trophy centered and comfortably inside the square canvas, strong readable silhouette at 72 CSS pixels. Soft studio lighting from upper left, subtle physical occlusion on the object, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object. Palette harmonizes with midnight navy #1e1e2c, pearl-white #eeeaff, lavender #aaa0ef and violet #7863df. Transparent background with genuine alpha. No letters, digits, logos, badge borders, text, extra objects, sparkles, or starbursts. The result must be an isolated cup with a clean silhouette, generous but consistent padding, not an app screen.
